description: This file defines the CreateThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder interface and its nested factories ResponseFactory and EventFactory, which are responsible for constructing command responses and events related to the CreateThing command within a live signals command handling framework.

classes.name: CreateThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface extending LiveCommandAnswerBuilder for creating responses and events related to CreateThing commands.

classes.name: CreateThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command responses, such as CreateThingResponse and error responses.

classes.name: CreateThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event objects, specifically ThingCreated events.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates an instance of CreateThingResponse or ThingCreated event using command values.

methods.name: thingConflictError
methods.description: Creates a ThingErrorResponse indicating a conflict.
